RAVI KUMAR RAWAT 
Securities Operations & Middle Office Professional 
Bhandup (W), Mumbai, Maharashtra | +91 9004808744 | ravik.gorp@gmail.com 
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
 
Securities Operations and Middle Office professional with 3+ years of experience at State Street Services, a 
leading global custodian bank. Promoted from Associate I to Associate II based on consistent performance. 
Specialized expertise in daily cash, stock, and custody reconciliation; ABS and MBS Principal & Interest 
reconciliation; trade lifecycle management; and corporate actions processing across global equities and fixed 
income markets. Proven ability to investigate and resolve aged breaks, conduct root cause analysis, and maintain 
data integrity in high-volume, SLA-driven environments. Proficient in Bloomberg Terminal, TLM, CAM/OSA, DTCC, 
IDS, MDS, and PLM. 
CORE COMPETENCIES 
 
 
• Cash, Stock & Custody Reconciliation • Operational Risk Management 
• Principal & Interest Reconciliation (ABS/MBS) • Root Cause Analysis 
• Two-Way & Break Investigation • MIS & Exception Reporting 
• Trade Lifecycle & Settlement Processing • Static Data Maintenance 
• Corporate Actions • Multi-Currency Portfolio Monitoring 
• Income Processing (Dividends, Coupons) • SLA & Deadline Management 
• Market Claims Management • Data Validation & Integrity 
 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
 
Securities Operations Analyst – Middle Office | State Street Services Pvt. Ltd. | Mumbai, IndiaFeb 2022 – 
Mar 2025 
Promoted: Associate I → Associate II based on consistent performance and operational excellence. 
Reconciliation & Income Processing 
• Executed daily two-way cash, stock, and custody reconciliations across multiple portfolios; maintained aged 
breaks through systematic break investigation and root cause analysis. 
• Managed Principal & Interest (P&I) reconciliation for Asset-Backed Securities (ABS) and Mortgage-Backed 
Securities (MBS), ensuring accurate cash flow tracking and allocation. 
• Processed dividend and coupon income events using Bloomberg Terminal, DTCC, IDS, and MDS platforms, 
validating payment calculations and ensuring timely client crediting. 
• Monitored TRR and WTX on multi-currency portfolios; applied accurate accounting adjustments for foreign 
exchange movements. 
• Managed trade settlements for global equities and fixed income securities; identified and resolved settlement 
failures to minimize client exposure and avoid penalties. 
• Coordinated claims management for missed income entitlements, working with custodians to ensure timely 
resolution of dividend and coupon claims. 
• Maintained security and operational static data with a strong focus on accuracy, control, and data integrity. 
• Ensured accurate income booking and raised market claims for missed entitlements across dividend and 
coupon income events. 
Control, Reporting & Stakeholder Coordination 
• Prepared daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports and exception reports for senior management and audit 
reviews, providing visibility into operational metrics and break statuses. 
• Partnered with cross-functional teams across EMEA and US Operations under rotational shift schedules to 
resolve breaks and improve process efficiency. 
• Ensured strict adherence to internal controls, SLA frameworks, and operational risk policies in a high-volume, 
deadline-driven environment. 
• Coordinated with internal teams, and external counterparties to resolve operational issues and prevent 
recurrence.
